description: IBM Granite Speech 5.0 2B autoregressive multilingual ASR (Conformer encoder, Q-Former projector, Granite text decoder). Transcribes English, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, and Japanese with punctuation and capitalization.

request.name: language
request.description: Source language hint: en, fr, de, es, pt, or ja (case-insensitive ASCII). The explicit request option wins over text_input.language. Blank (or omitted) means automatic recognition: no hint text and no language label.

request.name: target_language
request.description: Translation target: en, fr, de, es, pt, ja, it, or zh (case-insensitive ASCII; Italian and Mandarin render as Italian and Mandarin in the prompt). Blank (or omitted) means ASR transcription; setting a target selects speech translation. Source speech is described by language; keyword biasing terms travel in text_input.text (CLI --text, JSON text, multipart prompt|text) and combine with either mode.

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: Maximum generated tokens per audio chunk. The processor-derived context bound prompt_len + max_tokens <= 16384 (from actual token IDs and resampled audio) is enforced per chunk; hitting the budget returns the generated prefix.

request.name: audio_chunk_mode
request.description: Offline chunk mode: auto (short inputs whole, long inputs VAD when a VAD model is configured, else fixed), fixed, vad (requires granite_speech5.vad_model_path), or none.

request.name: audio_chunk_duration_sec
request.description: Positive maximum audio chunk duration in seconds, in (0, 120]. Ignored in none mode.

session.name: vad_model_path
session.description: Path to a VAD weight file of any built-in VAD family (e.g. silero_vad_16k.safetensors), not a directory; VAD runs only when this path is a regular file. Defaults to assets/framework/models/silero_vad.

session.name: encoder_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Maximum encoder graph metadata budget in MiB; allocation is shape-sized. Must be positive.

session.name: projector_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Maximum projector graph metadata budget in MiB; allocation is shape-sized. Must be positive.

session.name: prefill_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Decoder prefill graph arena size in MB. Must be positive.

session.name: decode_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Decoder step graph arena size in MB. Must be positive.

load.name: weight_type
load.description: Shared model weight storage type. Native keeps the stored dtype (checkpoint or GGUF package mixed types); f32 upcasts the BF16 snapshot for parity.

ui.summary: IBM Granite Speech 5.0 2B multilingual offline transcription (native weights, local GGUF conversion, or prebuilt Q8_0 package).
